purpose: Assess defensible inference sensitivity without changing the outcome, regressors, sample, point estimates or hypotheses
small_sample_conventions: exclude_FE_nested_within_any_cluster_dimension_from_small_sample_DoF; retain exact rank of remaining FE or one intercept when all FE nested
covariance: CGM inclusion-exclusion over all cluster intersections, each G/(G-1), times (N-1)/(N-K_slopes-K_FE_correction). Keep covariance unclipped; nonpositive target variance makes inference unavailable.
degrees_of_freedom: min(number of groups across chosen dimensions)-1 for t and F reference
nesting_validation: Every fixed-effect group must belong to exactly one cluster group before declaring it nested
primary_dependence_structure: Fund and issuer; fund shocks and reuse of issuer news across funds both matter. Single-dimension outputs are diagnostics, not a basis to choose the smallest p.
multiplicity: Show all raw p; Holm across the four existing tests per covariance/model, plus global sensitivity over all locked covariance/model/test slots. Missing inference stays null; conservative p=1 only for adjustment bookkeeping.
claim_limit: Post-hoc inference sensitivity on DW. A favorable covariance does not establish active total-return AT, causal effects, alpha, or robustness across all covariance conventions.
